title: RAW: shared boundary-run shorthand with an exact finite set-valued reader
summary: An invented marker-free writing rule shortens a left word when its final run repeats the next sourceword initial run. The right initial run supplies the missing character identity. It preserves all nonterminal material and nonempty group boundaries, but intentionally leaves bounded terminal-run ambiguity. An exact right-to-left reader enumerates only the genuine source preimages; no meaning is filled from a story.
